request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A close photograph of an open hand, palm up, over the rustic wooden counter of a covered market stall. The hand holds MONEY: three folded green banknotes and five silver and copper coins, clearly cash and nothing else. The banknotes are folded so that no portrait and no lettering is readable, and the coins show only plain blurred faces. The hand and the money are sharp and fill the middle of the photo; the market behind is softly blurred. Exactly one hand; no wallet, no phone, no card, no price card and no food. No readable letters, words or numbers anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
